# Parser fixtures

Representative of each channel's published export format (structure, property order, PRODID, all-day
`VALUE=DATE` with an exclusive `DTEND`). They are **not copied from a real listing**. A real export
reveals an address and the dates nobody is home, so real feeds are never committed; the real-data
check is the milestone I3 round trip against a live listing (docs/handoffs/C7.md). Reservation codes,
UIDs and phone digits are made up. Line endings are CRLF, as the channels send them.
